{{Top|leg}}
'''Yinta Lake spaceport''', located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Yinta Lake]], was the preeminent [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]]. In [[3653 BBY]], the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vrath Xizor]], who had been hired to prevent [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]]'s shipment of [[engspice]] from reaching the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Skirmish in the Yinta Lake spaceport|ambushed]] Korr in the spaceport. However, Korr was accompanied by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]], and together they were able to fend off Xizor's attack.
